SELECT dt.d_year , filtered_item.i_brand_id AS brand_id , filtered_item.i_brand AS brand , SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk , i_brand_id , i_brand FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id = 816) AS filtered_item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk 
JOIN date_dim dt ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk 
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11 
GROUP BY dt.d_year , filtered_item.i_brand , filtered_item.i_brand_id 
ORDER BY dt.d_year , sum_agg DESC , brand_id 
LIMIT 100
